description: Source code for FreeType library's patent checking functions related to TrueType bytecode instructions.

methods.name: _tt_check_patents_in_range
methods.description: Checks if the bytecode instructions in a given range contain patent-encumbered instructions.

methods.name: _tt_check_patents_in_table
methods.description: Checks if a specific font table contains patent-encumbered instructions.

methods.name: _tt_face_check_patents
methods.description: Checks if any glyphs in the font face contain patent-encumbered instructions.

methods.name: FT_Face_CheckTrueTypePatents
methods.description: Public API to check if a font face contains patent-encumbered TrueType instructions.

methods.name: FT_Face_SetUnpatentedHinting
methods.description: Sets whether to ignore patent restrictions for hinting in the font face.
